description: This source file defines a WearableListenerService named QuizListenerService for an Android quiz application. It listens for data item changes and messages related to quiz questions and quiz end events. The service manages notifications for quiz questions, including displaying question details, handling answer actions, and showing an overall quiz report upon completion. It interacts with Google Play Services Wearable API, manages notifications, and responds to message events to update the user interface accordingly.

classes.name: QuizListenerService
classes.description: An Android service extending WearableListenerService that listens for data and message events to manage quiz question notifications and final quiz report updates.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Handles data item change events to create or cancel notifications for quiz questions based on data changes.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages indicating quiz end or exit, and updates notifications accordingly.

methods.name: appendColored
methods.description: Utility method to append colored text to a SpannableStringBuilder.

methods.name: getResetQuizPendingIntent
methods.description: Creates a PendingIntent to trigger a reset quiz action when notified.
